description: Build a PyPI discovery paginator daemon - the third discovery source after npm and github. Searches PyPI via the JSON API for packages matching keywords mcp-server, model-context-protocol, anthropic-mcp, mcp-tools, and similar. Paginates with cursor persistence at /home/workspace/zo_sentinel/state/pypi_paginator_cursor.json. Per cycle (every 600s), processes up to 5 pages of 100 results = 500 candidates. For each PyPI package, extracts: name, version, summary, project_urls.Homepage, project_urls.Repository, classifiers, author. Computes server_id = blake2s(transport='pypi:' + name).hexdigest()[:16]. Inserts into mcp_discovery_candidates with status PENDING_SCAN via WriteService ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING. Logs FileHandler only. ws_write for all writes. ISO 8601 timestamps. Rate limits to 60 PyPI API calls per minute. Emits a discovery_batch mesh_event each cycle with counts.

context.author: CTO/CEO direct (Claude)
context.goal_link: PROJECT_GOALS.md - 20k MCP target. Currently at 5088/20000 = 25.4 percent. Need additional discovery sources beyond npm + github paginators.
context.why_now: At v2 candidate_promoter rate (500/cycle, 600s interval) the official MCP registry exhausts in ~2h. npm and github paginators add breadth. PyPI is the third major package registry hosting MCP servers and is currently uncovered.
constraints: ws_write via WriteService - ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
ISO 8601 string timestamps - never time.time() floats
Use pypi.org/pypi/{name}/json and pypi.org/search/?q={kw} (HTML scrape fallback if needed)
